elements.body: **How to use this page:** Pick a **Specialty** to filter every KPI and chart. Set the **Low-margin threshold** — the counter and detail tab update together. The **Low-margin placements** tab lists flagged prod assignments sorted by margin %. Use **Rate adjustments** / **Commission splits** tabs — click **+** to add a row (audit trail auto-captures who/when).
Click **+ Add row** below to log a bill or pay rate correction. Assignment number, field, original vs adjusted rate, and reason are required for finance audit.
Click **+ Add row** to record a commission split approval. Set status to Draft while reviewing, Approved when ready for payroll.
